svg.title: Farfbuzz time against HarfBuzz and HarfBuzzSharp, text by text

svg.text: Lower is better. Farfbuzz time divided by the other library’s time: left of the 1× line, Farfbuzz is faster
against HarfBuzz 15.1.0’s C++, .NET 10 with the JIT
